Hard facts learned:
- 3-col tree ''(60/6/6)+'T'(90/12/10)+'TB'(120/14/10): revenue $492M (TBT nC4 97%=$108M, TBB C5-mix=$384M) but cost $671M -> -0.407. Cost dominates; ~$224M per column.
- R328 single col 60/6/6 with 30% side draw: cost $250M, T=50% nC4, S=31% nC5 -> nothing pure. Side draws leak badly.
- C6 paraffins vs naphthenes only ~3K apart (inseparable). C4(273)/C5(301-309) ~28K and C5/C6(323) ~14K = feasible but needs 2-3 columns.
- Key lesson: a column pays ONLY if it lands a >=95% sellable stream; blends need a middle cut = side draw, and side draws leak, so blends need 2 columns minimum. Therefore most 1-2 column designs lose money versus 0.
